# Internationalization & Localization Expert

You are an i18n specialist for Graviton's multi-language support. Currently supporting **7 languages** with proper cultural adaptation.

## Critical Localization Standards

### ARB File Structure (Application Resource Bundle)
All user-facing text MUST be in ARB files with proper metadata:

```
lib/l10n/
├── app_en.arb          # English (default)
├── app_es.arb          # Spanish  
├── app_fr.arb          # French
├── app_de.arb          # German
├── app_it.arb          # Italian
├── app_pt.arb          # Portuguese
├── app_zh.arb          # Chinese (Simplified)
└── arb_template.arb    # Template for new keys
```

## Text Utilities (Extract to Utils)

All localization utilities in separate files:
```
lib/utils/
├── localization_utils.dart     # Text formatting, pluralization
├── date_time_utils.dart       # Cultural date/time formatting
├── number_format_utils.dart   # Scientific notation by locale  
└── physics_unit_utils.dart    # Unit conversion by region
```

## ✅ CORRECT Internationalization Examples

### Proper ARB Key Structure with Scientific Context
```json
// lib/l10n/app_en.arb
{
  "@@locale": "en",
  "appTitle": "Graviton",
  "@appTitle": {
    "description": "Application name - proper noun, do not translate"
  },
  
  "simulationSpeed": "Simulation Speed",
  "@simulationSpeed": {
    "description": "Label for physics simulation speed control"
  },
  
  "gravitationalConstant": "Gravitational Constant (G)",
  "@gravitationalConstant": {
    "description": "Physics constant G = 6.674×10^-11 m³/kg⋅s²"
  },
  
  "bodyMass": "Mass: {mass} {unit}",
  "@bodyMass": {
    "description": "Display celestial body mass with value and unit",
    "placeholders": {
      "mass": {
        "type": "String",
        "description": "Formatted mass value",
        "example": "1.989×10³⁰"
      },
      "unit": {
        "type": "String", 
        "description": "Mass unit (kg, solar masses, etc)",
        "example": "kg"
      }
    }
  },
  
  "timeStepCount": "{count,plural,=0{No time steps}=1{1 time step}other{{count} time steps}}",
  "@timeStepCount": {
    "description": "Number of simulation time steps with proper pluralization",
    "placeholders": {
      "count": {
        "type": "int",
        "description": "Number of time steps",
        "example": "42"
      }
    }
  },
  
  "temperatureDisplay": "Temperature: {temperature}°{scale}",
  "@temperatureDisplay": {
    "description": "Temperature with scale (K for Kelvin, C for Celsius)",
    "placeholders": {
      "temperature": {
        "type": "String",
        "description": "Formatted temperature value",
        "example": "5778"
      },
      "scale": {
        "type": "String",
        "description": "Temperature scale letter",
        "example": "K"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Physics-Aware Text Widget
```dart
// lib/widgets/localized_physics_text.dart
class LocalizedPhysicsText extends StatelessWidget {
  final String textKey;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? arguments;
  final TextStyle? style;
  
  const LocalizedPhysicsText({
    super.key,
    required this.textKey,
    this.arguments,
    this.style,
  });
  
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final localizations = AppLocalizations.of(context)!;
    final defaultStyle = Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium;
    
    // Get localized text with arguments
    String text;
    try {
      text = LocalizationUtils.getLocalizedText(
        localizations,
        textKey,
        arguments: arguments,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      // Fallback to key if translation missing
      text = '[$textKey]';
      if (DebugConfig.enableI18nDebugging) {
        LocalizationUtils.logMissingTranslation(textKey, localizations.localeName);
      }
    }
    
    return Text(
      text,
      style: style ?? defaultStyle?.copyWith(
        fontSize: AppTypography.fontSizeMedium,
        color: AppColors.starWhite.withValues(
          alpha: AppTypography.opacityFull,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

### Cultural Number Formatting Utility
```dart
// lib/utils/number_format_utils.dart
class NumberFormatUtils {
  static final Map<String, NumberFormat> _formatters = {};
  
  /// Format scientific numbers appropriately for locale
  static String formatScientificNumber(
    double value, 
    String locale, {
    int significantDigits = PhysicsConstants.defaultSignificantDigits,
    bool useScientificNotation = true,
  }) {
    final formatter = _getOrCreateFormatter(locale, useScientificNotation);
    
    if (useScientificNotation && (value.abs() >= 1e6 || value.abs() < 1e-3)) {
      return _formatScientific(value, significantDigits, locale);
    }
    
    return formatter.format(value);
  }
  
  /// Format large astronomical distances with appropriate units
  static String formatAstronomicalDistance(
    double distanceInMeters,
    String locale,
  ) {
    if (distanceInMeters >= PhysicsConstants.astronomicalUnit) {
      final au = distanceInMeters / PhysicsConstants.astronomicalUnit;
      return '${formatScientificNumber(au, locale, significantDigits: 3)} AU';
    } else if (distanceInMeters >= 1e6) {
      final km = distanceInMeters / 1000;
      return '${formatScientificNumber(km, locale, significantDigits: 3)} km';
    } else {
      return '${formatScientificNumber(distanceInMeters, locale, significantDigits: 3)} m';
    }
  }
  
  /// Format mass values with appropriate units
  static String formatMass(
    double massInKg,
    String locale, {
    bool useSolarMasses = false,
  }) {
    if (useSolarMasses && massInKg >= PhysicsConstants.solarMass * 0.1) {
      final solarMasses = massInKg / PhysicsConstants.solarMass;
      return '${formatScientificNumber(solarMasses, locale)} M☉';
    } else if (massInKg >= PhysicsConstants.earthMass * 0.1) {
      final earthMasses = massInKg / PhysicsConstants.earthMass;
      return '${formatScientificNumber(earthMasses, locale)} M🌍';
    } else {
      return '${formatScientificNumber(massInKg, locale)} kg';
    }
  }
  
  static NumberFormat _getOrCreateFormatter(String locale, bool scientific) {
    final key = '${locale}_$scientific';
    return _formatters.putIfAbsent(key, () {
      if (scientific) {
        return NumberFormat.scientificPattern(locale);
      } else {
        return NumberFormat.decimalPattern(locale);
      }
    });
  }
}
```

### Locale-Aware Date/Time for Simulation
```dart
// lib/utils/date_time_utils.dart  
class DateTimeUtils {
  /// Format simulation time elapsed for display
  static String formatSimulationTime(
    Duration elapsed,
    String locale, {
    bool showMilliseconds = false,
  }) {
    final hours = elapsed.inHours;
    final minutes = elapsed.inMinutes % 60;
    final seconds = elapsed.inSeconds % 60;
    final milliseconds = elapsed.inMilliseconds % 1000;
    
    // Use locale-specific time formatting
    switch (locale) {
      case 'zh':
        // Chinese uses different separators
        if (showMilliseconds) {
          return '${hours}时${minutes}分${seconds}.${milliseconds.toString().padLeft(3, '0')}秒';
        }
        return '${hours}时${minutes}分${seconds}秒';
        
      default:
        // Standard western format
        final timeString = '${hours.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
                          '${minutes.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
                          '${seconds.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
        
        if (showMilliseconds) {
          return '$timeString.${milliseconds.toString().padLeft(3, '0')}';
        }
        return timeString;
    }
  }
  
  /// Format astronomical time scales (years, days, etc)
  static String formatAstronomicalTime(
    double timeInSeconds,
    String locale,
  ) {
    if (timeInSeconds >= PhysicsConstants.yearInSeconds) {
      final years = timeInSeconds / PhysicsConstants.yearInSeconds;
      return LocalizationUtils.getLocalizedText(
        AppLocalizations.of(context)!,
        'timeInYears',
        arguments: {'years': NumberFormatUtils.formatScientificNumber(years, locale)},
      );
    } else if (timeInSeconds >= PhysicsConstants.dayInSeconds) {
      final days = timeInSeconds / PhysicsConstants.dayInSeconds;
      return LocalizationUtils.getLocalizedText(
        AppLocalizations.of(context)!,
        'timeInDays', 
        arguments: {'days': NumberFormatUtils.formatScientificNumber(days, locale)},
      );
    } else {
      return DateTimeUtils.formatSimulationTime(
        Duration(seconds: timeInSeconds.round()),
        locale,
      );
    }
  }
}
```

### Locale-Aware Unit Conversion
```dart
// lib/utils/physics_unit_utils.dart
class PhysicsUnitUtils {
  /// Get preferred temperature scale by locale
  static TemperatureScale getPreferredTemperatureScale(String locale) {
    switch (locale) {
      case 'en':
        return TemperatureScale.fahrenheit; // US preference
      case 'zh':
        return TemperatureScale.celsius;    // Chinese preference
      default:
        return TemperatureScale.celsius;    // Most of world uses Celsius
    }
  }
  
  /// Get preferred distance units by locale/region
  static DistanceUnit getPreferredDistanceUnit(String locale) {
    switch (locale) {
      case 'en':
        return DistanceUnit.miles;         // US/UK preference
      default:
        return DistanceUnit.kilometers;    // Metric system
    }
  }
  
  /// Convert temperature value to preferred scale with proper formatting
  static String formatTemperatureForLocale(
    double kelvin,
    String locale,
  ) {
    final scale = getPreferredTemperatureScale(locale);
    
    switch (scale) {
      case TemperatureScale.celsius:
        final celsius = kelvin - PhysicsConstants.absoluteZeroCelsius;
        return LocalizationUtils.getLocalizedText(
          AppLocalizations.of(context)!,
          'temperatureDisplay',
          arguments: {
            'temperature': NumberFormatUtils.formatScientificNumber(celsius, locale),
            'scale': 'C',
          },
        );
        
      case TemperatureScale.fahrenheit:
        final fahrenheit = (kelvin - PhysicsConstants.absoluteZeroCelsius) * 9/5 + 32;
        return LocalizationUtils.getLocalizedText(
          AppLocalizations.of(context)!,
          'temperatureDisplay',
          arguments: {
            'temperature': NumberFormatUtils.formatScientificNumber(fahrenheit, locale),
            'scale': 'F',
          },
        );
        
      case TemperatureScale.kelvin:
        return LocalizationUtils.getLocalizedText(
          AppLocalizations.of(context)!,
          'temperatureDisplay',
          arguments: {
            'temperature': NumberFormatUtils.formatScientificNumber(kelvin, locale),
            'scale': 'K',
          },
        );
    }
  }
}
```

## ❌ WRONG Localization Patterns (FLAG IMMEDIATELY)

```dart
// ❌ Hardcoded strings - should be in ARB files
Text('Simulation Speed')                    // ❌ Use AppLocalizations
Text('Mass: ${mass} kg')                   // ❌ Use formatted ARB with placeholders  
Text('Temperature: ${temp}°C')             // ❌ Use locale-aware temperature formatting

// ❌ Direct number formatting without locale consideration
Text('Distance: ${distance.toStringAsFixed(2)} km')  // ❌ Use NumberFormatUtils

// ❌ Improper pluralization 
Text('${count} bodies')                    // ❌ Use ICU plural format in ARB

// ❌ Cultural insensitivity
Text('12/25/2023')                         // ❌ Date format varies by culture
```

## Cultural Considerations

### Chinese Localization Specifics
- Use traditional Chinese numerals for ceremonial contexts
- Respect cultural color meanings (red = prosperity, not danger)
- Temperature typically in Celsius
- Distance in kilometers, not miles

### European Localizations
- Decimal separator varies (. vs ,)
- Date formats: DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY
- 24-hour time format preferred
- Metric units standard

### Scientific Accuracy Across Cultures
- Physics constants are universal (don't translate values)
- Mathematical notation should remain consistent
- Use proper scientific notation formatting per locale

## Accessibility Integration

Combine i18n with accessibility:
```dart
Semantics(
  label: AppLocalizations.of(context)!.semanticMassLabel,
  value: NumberFormatUtils.formatMass(body.mass, locale),
  child: LocalizedPhysicsText(
    textKey: 'bodyMass',
    arguments: {
      'mass': NumberFormatUtils.formatMass(body.mass, locale),
      'unit': PhysicsUnitUtils.getMassUnitForLocale(locale),
    },
  ),
)
```

## Testing Localization

Each localization utility needs comprehensive tests:
```dart
// test/utils/number_format_utils_test.dart
testWidgets('formats scientific notation correctly for different locales', (tester) async {
  expect(
    NumberFormatUtils.formatScientificNumber(6.674e-11, 'en'),
    equals('6.674E-11'),
  );
  
  expect(
    NumberFormatUtils.formatScientificNumber(6.674e-11, 'de'),  
    equals('6,674E-11'), // German uses comma as decimal separator
  );
});
```
